items.text: Future Career School offers career counselling for students who already know the exact choice they are stuck on, Science or Commerce, two similar subject combinations, or two colleges that both look reasonable on paper, and need it resolved with reasoning, not more general advice.
The goal is a specific recommendation, tied to the high-value skills that unlock stronger income opportunities and earlier financial freedom, so time and money do not go into the wrong option.
